Agentivism's four mechanisms
1.Delegated agency — what the learner
  assigns to AI and what they retain
  responsibility for
2.Epistemic monitoring and verification —
  whether AI outputs are critically evaluated
3.Reconstructive internalization —
  reworking AI-assisted output into
  independently usable knowledge and skill
4.Transfer under reduced support — learning
  is only evidenced when the learner can
  later apply knowledge with less or no AI
  assistance
    Yan, L., & Gašević, D. (2026). Agentivism: a learning theory for the age of artificial
    intelligence. arXiv preprint arXiv:2604.07813.
